_doc: Dashboard add-appointment dialog field validation (AddAppointmentDialog: firstNameTooShort / firstNameInvalid / lastNameInvalid / phoneInvalid drive per-field error states; canSave additionally needs service + slot). The dialog's date picker has no testid, so this spec asserts per-field aria-invalid instead of driving a full create — real appointment creation is covered by the public-booking flows. Driven by e2e/data-driven/add-appointment.spec.ts.
alwaysDisabledNote: add-appt-save stays disabled for every case above because no service/date/slot is selected — asserted once per case as a guard.
